published_statement: NOT QUOTED VERBATIM (source not readable here). Standard content of Einstein 1905: if a body gives off energy L as radiation, its mass diminishes by L/c^2; the mass of a body is a measure of its energy content. Derived by a two-pulse thought experiment and printed to second order in v/c (K0 - K1 = (1/2)(L/c^2) v^2). The absolute statement E0 = M c^2 for the total rest energy of a closed system is the later (Laue 1911 / Klein 1918) form. Both forms were re-derived here in sympy (script Parts A, B), which is what this audit relies on.
published_hypotheses: special relativity: Lorentz transformation of the energy of plane light waves (relativistic Doppler)
energy conservation in both inertial frames

the body's kinetic energy is identified with (Newtonian, O(v^2)) kinetic energy -- the single approximation in the 1905 argument (script A3/A5); with K = (gamma-1) m c^2 the result is exact at every v (A4)
1905 form fixes only DIFFERENCES: Delta m = Delta E / c^2; an additive constant in E is not fixed by the 1905 argument

absolute form (later): (E/c, p) is a four-vector (fixes the constant to 0, script B1/C1); for an extended body, a closed system in equilibrium (Laue: stresses integrate to zero) so that its energy-momentum is a four-vector
the equivalence is NOT a conversion mechanism: that all of M c^2 can be released requires a separate process (annihilation, black-hole evaporation) not asserted by the result

lacked_data: Einstein in 1905 had no test at all -- he proposed radium salts. Data he lacked and that came later: nuclear-reaction mass defects (1930s), full conversion in pair annihilation, and the direct test at (-1.4 +- 4.4)e-7 (Rainville 2005, NAMED-NOT-READ). Evidence either way: every later datum agrees with the relation; none disagrees at its stated precision. Computed consequence for the tree: moving the relation by its full 3-sigma band shifts the shortfall by < 1e-6 in log10 and leaves the 1e5-row slipped decade at x9.99 (script E1, E2). The deficiency that did exist was in the 1905 DERIVATION (an O(v^2) approximation and, as Ives argued, a disputed step), and that is closed by the exact relativistic re-derivation (A4) and the four-vector argument (B1, C1). M's hypothesis is therefore tested and NOT borne out for this result: the missing data would not, and does not, change the conclusion. The one thing that is not a consequence of E = M c^2 -- that the whole of M c^2 is released as a 'flash', and that a device must supply it -- is the folder's premise, and the owner names it as such.
grade_evidence: The statement as the tree uses it (absolute rest energy M c^2 of a closed body at rest, SR) is re-derived exactly here: sympy (A1-A5, B1-B2) and z3 (C1 UNSAT, C2 SAT vacuity guard). Every figure the tree prints from it is reproduced through the tree's own functions (D0-D7); the only disagreement is the folder document's 1e5-kg cell (8.98e22 vs 8.98755e21, x9.9916), which the owner correctly records as the document's internal inconsistency, and which no datum can reconcile (E3). c is SI-exact; the empirical test band moves nothing (E1, E2). The hypotheses the tree adds (full conversion; the store must supply M c^2) are named by the owner as the folder's premise (warpfolder.py:55-57, canonical hypotheses); the hypothesis it drops (closed system / binding) is harmless at 1.5e-25 (E4).
